products.name: Pega Platform for AI-Powered Workflow Automation
products.description: A unified enterprise software platform that enables organizations to automate and orchestrate business processes, workflows, and operations using AI, low-code development, and integration with technologies like RPA. Delivered as cloud-based or client-managed software, it supports digital transformation across industries.

products.name: Customer Engagement Applications (including Pega Customer Decision Hub)
products.description: Omnichannel customer engagement software, centered on the Pega Customer Decision Hub, that uses real-time AI-powered decisioning to personalize customer experiences, optimize marketing, and recommend next best actions across channels. Delivered as configurable applications on the Pega Platform.

products.name: Customer Service Applications
products.description: Enterprise customer service software that automates and guides customer interactions across channels, including contact center desktop, case management, chat, knowledge management, mobile field service, and AI-powered virtual assistants. Delivered as applications on the Pega Platform.

products.name: Sales Automation Applications
products.description: Software that automates and manages the sales process from prospecting to fulfillment, leveraging AI to guide sales teams and streamline onboarding. Delivered as part of the Pega Platform suite.

products.name: Legacy Transformation Solutions
products.description: Solutions that modernize and replace legacy systems by analyzing, reimagining, and rebuilding business processes using AI-powered design and low-code development on the Pega Platform, minimizing disruption and technical debt.

products.name: Low-Code Application Development Platform
products.description: A low-code platform enabling rapid development, prototyping, and deployment of enterprise applications, including multi-experience and mobile apps, using visual tools and AI assistance. Delivered as part of the Pega Platform and Blueprint suite.

products.name: Vertical-Specific Industry Solutions and Packaged Applications
products.description: Pre-built, configurable software solutions tailored for specific industries (e.g., financial services, healthcare, government, insurance, manufacturing), addressing use cases like onboarding, claims, case management, and compliance. Delivered as applications on the Pega Platform.

products.name: Pega Cloud Services
products.description: Cloud hosting and managed services for Pega applications and platform, providing secure, scalable infrastructure for development, testing, and deployment, with options for Pega-managed or client-managed cloud environments.

products.name: Professional Services (Consulting, Implementation, Support, Training)
products.description: Consulting, implementation, technical support, and training services to help clients plan, design, deploy, and maximize value from Pega software, delivered by internal teams and partners.

products.name: Exposure Management Platform (Tenable One)
products.description: A unified, AI-powered SaaS platform that provides comprehensive visibility, risk assessment, and prioritization across all types of assets and attack pathways, integrating vulnerability management, cloud security, identity protection, web app scanning, and attack surface management. Delivered digitally and leverages AI and machine learning for analytics and automation.

products.name: Vulnerability Assessment Solutions (Nessus)
products.description: A widely deployed vulnerability assessment product line, including Nessus Expert, that provides vulnerability scanning, web app scanning, infrastructure as code scanning, and external attack surface discovery. Delivered as software and SaaS, used by security professionals for asset discovery and vulnerability identification.

products.name: Operational Technology (OT) Security Solutions
products.description: A unified security solution for converged OT/IoT environments, providing threat detection, asset tracking, vulnerability management, and configuration control for industrial networks and critical infrastructure. Delivered as software and appliances, tailored for industrial and critical infrastructure customers.

products.name: Cybersecurity Solutions
products.description: A portfolio of software products, SDKs, and hardware devices that provide advanced authentication, fraud prevention, threat intelligence, and mobile application protection. Delivered via cloud-based and on-premises models, these solutions include multi-factor authentication, FIDO/passkey authentication, transaction signing, and mobile app shielding, requiring ongoing software development and integration with enterprise systems.

products.name: Digipass Authenticators
products.description: A line of hardware authentication devices, including one-button tokens, smart card readers, and FIDO2-certified passkeys, manufactured by third parties and used for multi-factor authentication and transaction signing. These devices are interoperable with software authentication solutions and are produced using custom microprocessors and electronic components.

products.name: Digital Agreement Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based solutions that automate and secure digital agreement workflows, including e-signatures, identity verification, and smart digital forms. Delivered primarily as SaaS, these solutions enable compliance, consent, and non-repudiation for customer transactions, and integrate with enterprise applications via APIs and pre-built connectors.

products.name: OneSpan Sign E-Signature Platform
products.description: A configurable, cloud-based electronic signature platform supporting a range of e-signature requirements, with options for public cloud and FedRAMP-compliant deployments. Enables organizations to automate agreement workflows, capture secure electronic evidence, and integrate with third-party applications via APIs and pre-built connectors.

products.name: OneSpan Notary
products.description: An online notary solution for organizations with in-house notaries, providing live electronic signature, secure videoconferencing, identity proofing, and workflow automation. Delivered as a cloud-based service, it streamlines notarization processes and compliance for digital transactions.

products.name: Identity Verification Services
products.description: A suite of cloud-based identity verification services, including document capture, real-time authenticity checks, facial comparison, and liveness detection, accessible via a single API. Used by banks and financial institutions to verify customer identities during digital transactions and agreement workflows.

products.name: Mobile Application Security and Shielding
products.description: Software development kits and frameworks that provide in-app security, dynamic linking, authentication orchestration, and mobile application shielding against malware and code injection. Delivered as SDKs for integration into customer mobile apps, these solutions protect applications in hostile environments and support secure mobile transactions.

products.name: Senior and Secured Lending to Middle Market Companies
products.description: Provision of senior and secured first lien loans, and to a lesser extent, second lien loans, primarily to private U.S. middle market companies. These loans are originated directly and are secured by company assets, requiring significant financial capital and credit analysis expertise.

products.name: Equity and Equity-Linked Investments in Middle Market Companies
products.description: Investments in equity and equity-linked instruments such as convertible debt, preferred equity, common equity, and warrants in private U.S. middle market companies. These investments are structured for capital appreciation and may involve active ownership or control.

products.name: Real Estate Investments via REITs
products.description: Investments in senior and secured debt and controlling equity positions in real estate investment trusts (REITs), including multi-family and tenant-diversified properties. These are physical real estate assets managed for current yield and capital appreciation.

products.name: Investments in Broadly-Traded Public Companies
products.description: Investments in the debt and equity instruments of broadly-traded public companies, including non-investment grade debt securities. These are financial investments in liquid markets, subject to regulatory portfolio limits.

products.name: Structured Credit Investments (CLOs and Tranches)
products.description: Investments in collateralized loan obligations (CLOs), including equity and junior debt tranches, which are pools of senior and secured loans to below-investment-grade companies. These are financial products requiring specialized structuring and risk management.

products.name: Capital Markets Services
products.description: Comprehensive services including investment sales, commercial mortgage origination, debt and equity placement, loan sales, and structured finance for commercial real estate assets. Delivered by professionals leveraging relationships with investors and capital sources, requiring financial expertise and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: GSE/FHA Lending and Loan Servicing
products.description: Origination, sale, and servicing of multifamily and commercial real estate loans through government-sponsored (Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac) and HUD FHA programs. Involves regulated lending, use of warehouse facilities, and ongoing loan servicing for recurring revenue.

products.name: Leasing Services (Landlord and Tenant Representation)
products.description: Representation of landlords and tenants in commercial real estate leasing, including strategic planning, site selection, lease negotiation, and occupancy solutions. Delivered by brokers using market data and technology, typically earning commissions on executed leases.

products.name: Property and Facilities Management
products.description: Contractual management of office, industrial, retail, and specialized properties, including building operations, maintenance, vendor management, financial reporting, and facilities management for occupiers. Requires in-person labor, regulated practices, and technology-enabled oversight.

products.name: Valuation and Advisory (V&A) Services
products.description: Valuation and advisory services for commercial real estate, including appraisals, portfolio analytics, feasibility studies, and financial reporting. Delivered by professionals using proprietary data and digital tools, supporting transactions and compliance.

products.name: Flexible Workspace Solutions
products.description: Provision of amenity-rich, flexible work environments and office space solutions for owners and occupiers, primarily in Europe and North America. Involves physical space management and hospitality services.

products.name: Occupier Solutions (Consulting and Outsourcing)
products.description: Consulting and outsourcing services for real estate occupiers, including project management, transaction management, lease administration, workplace strategy, energy and sustainability solutions, and portfolio advisory. Delivered through multi-year contracts, leveraging technology and data analytics.

products.name: Business Rates Services (U.K.)
products.description: Management of business rates payments, appeals, and reliefs for U.K. property owners and occupiers. Involves processing large volumes of payments and navigating regulatory frameworks, generating recurring revenue.

products.name: Property Due Diligence and Transaction Support
products.description: Due diligence, data management, transaction support, performance analytics, and title and escrow services for real estate transactions. Delivered by specialized teams, often as part of broader transaction or consulting engagements.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Technology Platform
products.description: Provision of digital platforms and technology solutions for real estate data, analytics, workflow automation, and client advisory. Delivered as software and data services to clients and professionals, supporting efficiency and decision-making.

products.name: Expense Management Platform
products.description: A cloud-based software platform that automates the capture, approval, and reimbursement of employee expenses, leveraging patented receipt scanning (SmartScan), AI-driven workflows, and integrations with accounting and HR systems. Delivered as a digital SaaS product accessible via web and mobile apps.

products.name: Corporate Card Program (Expensify Card)
products.description: A corporate credit card solution integrated with the expense management platform, offering real-time transaction visibility, spend controls, automatic reconciliation, and cashback rewards. Cards are issued via the Visa network and managed digitally through Expensify's platform.

products.name: Travel Management Platform (Expensify Travel)
products.description: A digital travel booking and management service integrated into the Expensify platform, enabling users to book flights, hotels, rail, and car rentals, with policy-driven approvals, centralized payments, and real-time collaboration. Delivered via web and mobile applications.

products.name: Invoicing and Bill Payment Platform
products.description: A digital invoicing and bill payment solution that allows businesses to generate and send invoices, pay bills, collect payments, and automate accounts payable/receivable processes. Features include SmartScan for bills, multiple payment options, and integrations with accounting systems.

products.name: Receipt and Mileage Tracking for Individuals
products.description: A digital tool for individuals and sole proprietors to track receipts and mileage, leveraging SmartScan technology, with optional upgrades for higher usage. Delivered as a mobile and web application.

products.name: Middle-Market Debt Financing
products.description: Provision of first lien secured debt, second lien secured debt, and subordinated debt to U.S. middle-market companies, typically through privately negotiated transactions. These are structured, actively managed loans requiring financial capital, underwriting, and ongoing portfolio management.

products.name: Equity Investments in Middle-Market Companies
products.description: Direct equity investments, including warrants and options, in U.S. middle-market companies, often as a minority interest or in conjunction with debt financing. These investments are typically made alongside or as part of debt transactions and may involve both private and thinly traded public companies.

products.name: Joint Venture Investment Management (PSLF)
products.description: Co-management and capital provision to a joint venture (PSLF) that invests primarily in middle-market and other corporate debt securities, consistent with the company's core strategy. This involves financial capital and investment management expertise.

products.name: Investment Technology and Operations Outsourcing
products.description: Comprehensive technology and operational infrastructure services for front, middle, and back office functions, including business process outsourcing, custody, fund administration, depositary, investment accounting, investor servicing, regulatory compliance, and data management. Delivered via proprietary platforms (SEI Wealth Platform, TRUST 3000) as SaaS or PaaS, requiring significant technology development, regulated infrastructure, and in-person operational support.

products.name: Asset Management Solutions
products.description: Provision of investment management services and products, including ETFs, mutual funds, collective investment trusts (CITs), separately managed accounts (SMAs), alternative investments, and model portfolios. products.name: Custody and Trust Services
products.description: Trust-based custody and related services for client assets, integrated with wealth technology platforms. Assets are held in clients’ names, with no commingling, pledging, or margining, and supported by regulated trust company infrastructure and compliance.

products.name: Alternative Investment Administration and Access
products.description: Administration, processing, and access solutions for alternative investments and private markets, including private credit, interval funds, and retail-accessible alternatives. products.name: Outsourced Chief Investment Officer (OCIO) Services
products.description: Fully outsourced and unbundled investment management services for institutional investors, including portfolio construction, implementation, risk management, and analytics. Delivered through a combination of investment expertise, technology platforms, and operational support.

products.name: Professional and Advisory Services
products.description: Consultative and implementation services for clients, including business transformation, platform implementation, practice management, and succession planning. Delivered by specialized teams leveraging technology and industry expertise, often as part of broader solution bundles.

products.name: Cybersecurity and Managed Security Services
products.description: Managed cybersecurity and security operations services, including cloud infrastructure, data protection, and compliance support, delivered through platforms such as SEI Sphere™. Requires specialized technology and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Video and Online Retail Commerce
products.description: Curated consumer products sold through live and recorded video-driven commerce across broadcast TV, streaming, social media, websites, and mobile applications. Products are sourced from vendors and promoted via storytelling and celebrity endorsements, with fulfillment through centralized distribution centers and third-party carriers.

products.name: Home Furnishings and Décor
products.description: Premium and affordable indoor and outdoor furniture, accessories, rugs, and décor sold under brands such as Frontgate, Ballard Designs, and Grandin Road, delivered via catalogs, branded websites, and retail/outlet stores. Products are developed in-house or with designers and manufacturers, with exclusive and proprietary offerings.

products.name: Apparel and Accessories
products.description: Apparel and accessories, including proprietary and branded lines, sold through video commerce, digital platforms, and CBI's Garnet Hill brand. Products are distributed via online, catalog, and retail channels, with in-house design and exclusive partnerships.

products.name: Beauty Products
products.description: Cosmetic and beauty products, including exclusive and national brands, sold through video commerce, digital platforms, and catalogs. Products are demonstrated and promoted via live programming and digital content, with fulfillment through centralized distribution.

products.name: Jewelry
products.description: Jewelry products, including proprietary and branded lines, sold through video commerce, digital platforms, and catalogs. Products are promoted via live demonstrations and storytelling, with fulfillment through centralized distribution.

products.name: Consumer Electronics
products.description: Consumer electronics, including national brands, sold through video commerce, digital platforms, and catalogs. Products are demonstrated live and online, with fulfillment through centralized distribution centers and third-party carriers.

products.name: Veterinary Hospital Services
products.description: Comprehensive veterinary care for companion animals, primarily dogs and cats, delivered through owned and operated physical hospitals. Services include preventive care (annual exams, parasite control, dental health, nutrition counseling, radiology, bloodwork, skin and coat health), surgical procedures (soft tissue, orthopedic, spays/neuters, mass removals, gastropexies, splenectomies), and breed-specific preventive care. Care is provided in-person by licensed veterinarians and staff in regulated clinical settings.

products.name: Emergency and Critical Care Veterinary Services
products.description: Emergency and critical care services for companion animals, including urgent and complex medical interventions, provided at select hospital locations. These services require specialized veterinary expertise, regulated infrastructure, and are delivered in-person at physical hospital facilities.

products.name: Mixed Animal and Equine Veterinary Services
products.description: Veterinary care for mixed animal practices, including services for equine and, in the future, bovine animals, delivered through select hospital locations. This involves in-person care by veterinarians with specialized training in large animal medicine, using regulated clinical facilities.

products.name: Holistic and Alternative Veterinary Care
products.description: Alternative and holistic veterinary services such as acupuncture, chiropractic, and other wellness offerings, provided at certain hospital locations by trained professionals. These services are delivered in-person and supplement traditional veterinary care.

products.name: Apartment Rental Services
products.description: Centerspace owns, manages, acquires, develops, and redevelops apartment communities, providing rental housing to residents in various metropolitan areas. This service involves physical real estate assets and in-person property management operations.

products.name: Lapiplasty 3D Bunion Correction System
products.description: A proprietary system combining surgical instruments, single-use sterile implant kits, and patented surgical methods to correct all three planes of bunion deformity and stabilize the unstable joint. Manufactured using precision engineering and titanium fixation, delivered through direct sales to surgeons and hospitals.

products.name: Minimally Invasive Bunion Correction Systems (Nanoplasty and Percuplasty)
products.description: Instrumented surgical systems for minimally invasive 3D bunion correction, including the Nanoplasty and Percuplasty platforms, utilizing specialized implants, powered saws or burrs, and small incisions to enable reproducible correction with cosmetic and recovery benefits. Delivered as kits with implants and instruments to surgical providers.

products.name: Adductoplasty Midfoot Correction System
products.description: A comprehensive system of implants and precision instruments for surgical correction of midfoot deformities (metatarsus adductus and osteoarthritis), including reusable and single-use components for fusion procedures, with options for minimally invasive approaches. Delivered as procedure-specific kits to surgeons.

products.name: SpeedPlate Rapid Compression Implant Platform
products.description: A platform of titanium fixation implants designed for rapid insertion and dynamic compression in bone fusion procedures of the foot, compatible with both proprietary and other surgical systems. Includes specialized designs for various joints and minimally invasive techniques. Delivered as sterile-packed implants to surgical facilities.

products.name: SpeedMTP System for Great Toe Fusions
products.description: A specialized implant system for metatarsophalangeal (MTP) joint fusion in patients with arthritic bunions, combining low-profile titanium plates and locking screws for fast insertion and robust fixation. Delivered as sterile implant kits to surgeons.

products.name: IntelliGuide Patient-Specific Instrumentation
products.description: A digital solution using patient CT scan data and proprietary software to create 3D pre-operative plans and 3D-printed, patient-specific surgical cut guides for bunion and midfoot correction procedures. Delivered as custom kits to surgeons for each patient.

products.name: Sterile Surgical Instruments
products.description: A line of single-use, sterile-packed surgical instruments designed to address specific procedural needs in bunion and midfoot surgeries, including bone harvesting, ligament release, bone contouring, and osteotomy tools. Manufactured and distributed as disposable kits to surgical providers.

products.name: Biologics and Allograft Wedges
products.description: Pre-shaped allograft bone wedges and flowable cortical fiber products used to facilitate bone healing and correction in foot surgeries. Manufactured from donor tissue and delivered as sterile-packed biologic products to surgical facilities.

products.name: Hammertoe PEEK Fixation System
products.description: A sterile-packed implant and instrument kit made from PEEK (polyether ether ketone) for the surgical correction of hammertoe, claw toe, and mallet toe deformities, offering radiolucency and bone-like mechanical properties. Delivered as kits to surgeons for foot deformity repairs.

products.name: Exome and Genome Sequencing Tests
products.description: Comprehensive exome and whole genome sequencing tests (including ExomeDx™ and GenomeDx™) for diagnosing rare and ultra-rare genetic disorders, primarily delivered through high-complexity CLIA-certified laboratory operations and supported by proprietary bioinformatics and AI-driven interpretation pipelines.

products.name: Genomic Newborn Screening
products.description: Whole genome-based newborn screening protocols (gNBS) that use genome sequencing to screen for a broad range of conditions at birth, delivered through laboratory testing and interpretation services, with ongoing research collaborations to support clinical adoption.

products.name: Cloud-Based Genomic Interpretation and Information Services
products.description: Remote, cloud-based genomic data analysis and interpretation services that allow healthcare partners to access GeneDx’s analysis capabilities while sequencing is performed locally, leveraging proprietary bioinformatics and machine learning tools.

products.name: Data and Biopharma Partnership Solutions
products.description: Data-driven solutions and analytic services for biopharmaceutical companies, including patient finding for clinical trials, support for targeted therapy development, and access to de-identified clinicogenomics data for research and drug discovery, leveraging the GeneDx Infinity™ dataset.

products.name: Ion Implantation Systems
products.description: Axcelis designs, manufactures, and sells ion implantation equipment used in the fabrication of semiconductor chips. These are large, technically advanced systems that inject dopants into silicon or silicon carbide wafers, and are delivered as physical capital equipment to semiconductor manufacturers worldwide.

products.name: Aftermarket Lifecycle Products and Services
products.description: Axcelis provides aftermarket support for its installed base of equipment, including used tools, spare parts, equipment upgrades, maintenance services, and customer training. products.name: Appian Process Automation Platform

products.name: Professional Services for Platform Implementation
products.description: Consulting and implementation services provided by Appian's team of specialists to help customers build, deploy, and optimize applications on the Appian platform, ensuring successful adoption and achievement of process automation goals. products.name: Pre-Built Industry Solutions
products.description: Pre-configured software solutions built on the Appian platform, tailored for specific industry use cases (e.g., financial services, government, life sciences, insurance, manufacturing), enabling faster deployment and value realization for customers in those sectors. products.name: Hardware Products

products.name: IT Services
products.description: Professional and managed IT services such as advisory, design, software development, implementation, integration, migration, and ongoing management. products.name: Cloud Solutions
products.description: Public, private, and hybrid cloud solutions, including cloud migration, integration, and management services. These solutions leverage partnerships with major cloud providers and are delivered as subscriptions or managed services.

products.name: Security Solutions
products.description: Comprehensive security offerings including hardware, software, and services such as endpoint security, identity and access management, firewalls, security consulting, and managed security services. products.name: Collaboration and Digital Experience Solutions
products.description: Solutions that enable communication and productivity, including collaboration hardware and software, unified communications, cloud-based collaboration platforms, and digital workspace tools. Delivered through integration of devices, applications, and cloud services.

products.description: Custom application development, modernization, integration, and digital transformation services, including cloud-native deployment, DevOps, AI, and automation. Delivered by engineering teams to modernize customer IT infrastructure and operations.

products.name: Talent Orchestration Solutions
products.description: Provision of technical resources and workforce augmentation for project-based engagements and periods of peak demand, supplementing customer IT teams with specialized talent.

products.description: Research and development of additional small molecule drug candidates originating from internal drug discovery efforts, focused on identifying and validating new drug targets using gene knockout technologies and advanced medical technologies. products.description: Markets and facilitates motorcycle insurance and voluntary protection products, including service contracts, to motorcycle owners and dealerships, primarily through third-party providers.

products.description: Provision and management of prescription drug services, including dispensing, cost-management, and compliance with regulatory requirements, primarily for PACE participants. Production involves individualized cell processing and regulated biologics manufacturing.

products.name: CD19/CD22 Dual-Targeted ARTEMIS T-Cell Therapy (EB104)
products.description: A next-generation autologous T-cell therapy using ARTEMIS® technology to target both CD19 and CD22 antigens on B-cell malignancies, designed to overcome antigen loss and relapse. Manufactured through advanced cellular engineering and delivered as a personalized infusion.

products.name: CD19-Redirected ARTEMIS T-Cell Therapy for Autoimmune Diseases (EB201)
products.description: A preclinical autologous T-cell therapy program using ARTEMIS® technology to target autoreactive B cells in autoimmune diseases such as systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE). Therapy is produced via cellular engineering and intended for infusion to deplete pathogenic B cells.

products.name: CD19-Directed ARTEMIS T-Cell Therapy for Solid Tumors (in combination with CF33-CD19t)
products.description: A combination therapy using ARTEMIS® CD19-directed T-cells (EB103) with Imugene’s oncolytic virus CF33-CD19t to induce CD19 expression on solid tumor cells, enabling targeted T-cell killing. This approach requires both viral and cellular manufacturing and is delivered via infusion and viral administration.

products.name: Oil and Natural Gas Production
products.description: Exploration, development, production, and acquisition of oil and natural gas resources, primarily from shale and unconventional plays in the Delaware Basin (Southeast New Mexico and West Texas) and to a lesser extent in Northwest Louisiana. This involves physical extraction using drilling, hydraulic fracturing, and completion operations, requiring significant capital investment and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Midstream Services
products.description: Provision of midstream services to third parties, including natural gas processing, oil transportation, oil, natural gas and produced water gathering, and produced water disposal. These services are delivered through owned and operated infrastructure such as pipelines, processing plants, compressor stations, and disposal wells, and require regulatory compliance and significant physical assets.

products.name: Precision Metal Fabricated and Machined Components for Defense Applications
products.description: Custom, large-scale metal components and systems manufactured to customer specifications for defense industry applications, including submarines, aircraft carriers, military aircraft, and helicopters. Production involves heavy fabrication, precision machining, assembly, integration, inspection, and testing in compliance with military and regulatory standards.

products.name: Precision Metal Fabricated and Machined Components for Aerospace Applications
products.description: Custom, large-scale metal components and assemblies manufactured to customer specifications for aerospace industry applications, including commercial and military aircraft and space programs. Production includes high-precision fabrication, machining, assembly, and specialized processes such as electron beam welding and non-destructive testing.

products.name: Precision Metal Fabricated and Machined Components for Precision Industrial Applications
products.description: Custom, large-scale metal components and systems manufactured to customer specifications for precision industrial markets. Production involves fabrication, machining, assembly, and inspection, primarily for industrial equipment and systems requiring high precision.

products.name: Tooling, Molds, Fixtures, Jigs, and Dies for Aerospace and Defense Manufacturing
products.description: Design and manufacture of specialized tooling, molds, fixtures, jigs, and dies used in the production of aircraft and defense components. These are custom-built to customer specifications and support manufacturing processes for mission-critical applications.

products.name: Manufacturing Engineering Services
products.description: Engineering services provided to customers to optimize their product designs for manufacturing efficiency, including manufacturability analysis and process planning. These services are offered as part of the custom manufacturing process but can also be provided as standalone services.

products.name: IHOP Restaurant Franchising
products.description: Franchising of IHOP full-service family dining restaurants, generating revenue primarily from royalties and advertising fees. Restaurants are operated by independent franchisees who develop, own, and manage the locations under the IHOP brand.

products.name: Applebee’s Restaurant Franchising
products.description: Franchising of Applebee’s Neighborhood Grill + Bar full-service casual dining restaurants, with revenue from franchise royalties and advertising fees. Franchisees are responsible for developing and operating Applebee’s-branded restaurants.

products.name: Fuzzy’s Taco Shop Restaurant Franchising
products.description: Franchising of Fuzzy’s Taco Shop limited-service fast-casual restaurants, focused on regionally-inspired Mexican food and beverages. Revenue is generated from franchise royalties and development fund contributions.

products.name: Company-Owned Restaurant Operations
products.description: Operation of company-owned IHOP, Applebee’s, and Fuzzy’s restaurants, generating revenue directly from food and beverage sales to customers. These restaurants are managed and staffed by the company rather than franchisees.

products.name: Restaurant Property Leasing and Subleasing
products.description: Leasing or subleasing of restaurant properties, primarily to IHOP and Applebee’s franchisees, generating rental income. The company owns or leases sites and then subleases them to franchise operators.

products.name: Sale of Proprietary Restaurant Products to Franchisees
products.description: Sale of proprietary IHOP and Fuzzy’s branded products to franchisees for use in their restaurants, supporting brand consistency and quality across the franchise system.

products.name: Digital Energy Solutions
products.description: A suite of digital platforms, applications, and services—including cloud-based SaaS, AI-powered workflow automation, real-time field operations, and exploration data libraries—delivered digitally to optimize energy operations across the value chain.

products.name: Reservoir Evaluation and Stimulation Services
products.description: Physical and analytical services to evaluate, stimulate, and intervene in oil and gas reservoirs, including wireline logging, downhole testing, hydraulic fracturing, and well intervention, delivered through specialized equipment and expert personnel.

products.name: Well Construction Solutions
products.description: Integrated products and services for the design, drilling, and construction of oil and gas wells, including drilling fluids, equipment, drill bits, measurements, and turnkey well construction management, involving manufacturing, engineering, and field operations.

products.name: Production Systems and Equipment
products.description: Comprehensive portfolio of equipment and services to enhance oil and gas production, including subsea systems, artificial lift, completions, surface production equipment, process technologies, production chemicals, and valves, manufactured and deployed globally.

products.name: Asset Performance Solutions
products.description: Integrated field production project management, combining SLB’s products, services, drilling rig management, and engineering expertise to deliver turnkey solutions for production improvement, typically under long-term contracts.

products.name: Data Center Solutions
products.description: Design and manufacture of modular data center infrastructure components—such as enclosures, cooling systems, and hardware—delivered to hyperscalers and enterprises, leveraging scalable, standardized production.

products.name: Carbon Capture Solutions (SLB Capturi)
products.description: Carbon capture technologies, solutions, and services for industrial decarbonization, delivered through a joint venture to hard-to-abate industries, including design, deployment, and management of carbon capture systems.

products.name: Advertising Solutions
products.description: A suite of digital advertising products delivered via Nextdoor's proprietary platform, including self-serve and managed campaign options, hyperlocal targeting, diverse ad formats (sponsored posts, display, video), and measurement tools. These are delivered digitally to businesses of all sizes seeking to reach local audiences.

products.name: Neighborhood Social Networking Platform
products.description: A digital platform enabling neighbors to connect, share news, participate in discussions, receive real-time safety alerts, and access locally relevant content. Delivered as a web and mobile application, it leverages AI and ML for content personalization and moderation.

products.name: Local Marketplace (For Sale & Free)
products.description: A digital marketplace feature within the Nextdoor platform where neighbors can buy, sell, or donate items locally. Transactions are facilitated peer-to-peer through the platform's web and mobile interfaces.

products.name: Business Pages and Local Business Discovery Tools
products.description: Digital business pages and discovery tools that allow local businesses to create a presence, receive recommendations, and connect with neighbors. Delivered via the Nextdoor platform, these tools are free and support business visibility and engagement.

products.name: Public Agency Communication Tools
products.description: A set of digital tools enabling public agencies (e.g., fire departments, law enforcement, municipal offices) to share real-time updates, critical alerts, and community information with local residents via the Nextdoor platform.

products.name: Unsecured Personal Loans
products.description: Affordable, unsecured, fully amortizing installment loans with fixed payments, originated digitally or through retail locations, using proprietary AI-driven underwriting. Loans range from $300 to $10,000 with terms of 12 to 54 months.

products.name: Secured Personal Loans
products.description: Personal installment loans secured by an automobile, allowing access to larger loan sizes. Underwritten using proprietary technology and collateral evaluation, offered digitally and through retail locations in select states.

products.name: Savings Platform (Set & Save)
products.description: A digital savings product that uses machine learning to analyze members’ cash flows and automate small, frequent transfers to help users achieve personalized savings goals. Delivered via mobile app and web, integrated with members’ bank accounts.

products.name: Lending as a Service (Lead Generation Partnerships)
products.description: Lead generation and lending partnerships with third-party companies, enabling Oportun to offer its lending and financial services products through partner retail locations and digital channels.

products.name: Optical Communications Devices and Modules
products.description: Manufactured optical communications components and modules, including selective switching products (ROADMs, optical amplifiers, modulators), tunable lasers, transceivers, transponders, and active optical cables. Production involves advanced optical packaging, precision assembly, and testing in high-volume, regulated manufacturing environments.

products.name: Industrial Lasers
products.description: Manufactures solid state, diode-pumped, gas, and fiber lasers for use in semiconductor processing, biotechnology, medical devices, metrology, and materials processing. Production requires precision optical and electro-mechanical assembly and testing.

products.name: Automotive and Industrial Sensors
products.description: Produces a range of sensors, including differential pressure, micro-gyro, fuel, and non-contact temperature measurement sensors for automotive and medical applications. Manufacturing involves advanced precision assembly and testing.

products.name: Customized Optics and Glass Products
products.description: Designs and fabricates customized glass and crystal optics, including fiber optic ferrules, alignment sleeves, substrates, laser optics, medical optics, storage optics, surveying optics, telecom optics, and telecommunication subassemblies. These are sold both as components and incorporated into higher-level assemblies. Production involves crystal growth, glass processing, coating, and precision fabrication.

products.name: Precision Optical, Electro-Mechanical, and Electronic Manufacturing Services
products.description: Provides integrated contract manufacturing services for OEMs, including process design and engineering, advanced optical packaging, printed circuit board assembly and test, new product introduction, supply chain management, and quality control. Services are delivered through large-scale, technologically advanced manufacturing facilities, often in a 'factory-within-a-factory' model for IP protection.

products.name: Hospital Services
products.description: Operation of 50 acute care and specialty hospitals providing inpatient and outpatient medical services, including emergency care, surgery, intensive care, specialty care (cardiac, neurosciences, orthopedics, etc.), and advanced treatment options. Delivered through physical facilities staffed by medical professionals and regulated under state and federal laws.

products.name: Ambulatory Surgery Services
products.description: Operation of 533 ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs) and 26 surgical hospitals offering outpatient surgical procedures across specialties such as orthopedics, gastroenterology, pain management, ophthalmology, and urology. Services are delivered in specialized outpatient facilities, often through joint ventures with physicians and health systems.

products.name: Outpatient Care Services
products.description: Operation of 132 outpatient facilities, including urgent care centers, imaging centers, off-campus emergency departments, and micro-hospitals, providing non-inpatient medical services such as diagnostics, urgent care, and minor procedures. Delivered through physical centers, often in partnership with other providers.

products.name: Physician Practice Services
products.description: Ownership and operation of physician practices, employing or affiliating with over a thousand physicians to provide a range of medical services in office-based settings. Services are delivered through in-person physician labor and are subject to state regulations on corporate practice of medicine.

products.name: Revenue Cycle Management Services
products.description: Provision of revenue cycle management solutions to hospitals, health systems, physician practices, employers, and other clients, including insurance verification, billing, collections, coding, and financial counseling. Delivered primarily through Conifer Health Solutions using a combination of technology platforms and specialized human labor.

products.name: Value-Based Care Services
products.description: Provision of value-based care services such as clinical integration, financial risk management, and population health management to healthcare providers and employers, aiming to improve cost, quality, and patient outcomes. Delivered through consulting, analytics, and management services, primarily via Conifer Health Solutions.
